primitive.name: Speck32/64
primitive.round: L_next = (ROR16(L, 7) + R mod 2^16) XOR round_key; R_next = ROL16(R, 2) XOR L_next
primitive.difference: XOR difference; round-key XOR cancels in a fixed-key differential transition
primitive.bit_numbering: Within each 16-bit word, bit 0 is the least significant bit. Hex pairs below are (L, R).

continuous_difference_semantics.encoding: For each difference bit, correlation value rho is +1 for bit 1 and -1 for bit 0.
continuous_difference_semantics.majority: maj_c(x, y, z) = (x + y + z + x*y*z)/4
continuous_difference_semantics.addition: For bit i from LSB to MSB, c_0=-1, z_i=x_i*y_i*c_i, c_(i+1)=maj_c(x_i,y_i,c_i). Final carry is discarded.
continuous_difference_semantics.rotation: Correlation coordinates are rotated exactly as the corresponding 16-bit word.
continuous_difference_semantics.middle_correlation_rule: Multiply the absolute correlation values at all active positions of the round-7 linear input mask.

linear_correlation_definition: For addition masks (a,b,c), C_add(a,b,c)=2^-32 * sum_{x,y in F_2^16} (-1)^(<a,x> XOR <b,y> XOR <c,(x+y mod 2^16)>). Account for the Speck rotations and XOR fork when deriving each round's addition masks.
